facts.quote: Stone Heart has no love and sees the festival as an insult.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (The Festival of Hearts Returns!)
article_summaries.summary: An official Free Realms news post announcing that the Festival of Hearts had returned to Merry Vale, with daily and members-only quests, Marketplace and Coin Shop items, and the Stone Heart and Heartbreakers storyline. It also gives the festival's background legend of Rylan and Arianna and how to reach the event via the Merry Vale Warpstone. The post gives only a relative date ('1 week, 3 days ago') and no exact date.
